events.title: IMF And World Bank Hold 2026 Spring Meetings
events.summary: The 2026 Spring Meetings of the International Monetary Fund and World Bank Group took place in Washington, D.C., from April 13 to 18.
events.context: The meetings gather central bankers, finance ministers, development officials, civil society, academics, and private-sector leaders around global economic policy.
events.whyItMatters: The meetings are a major venue for international economic coordination, development finance, and debate over the state of the global economy.

events.detailMarkdown:
The IMF and World Bank Group held their 2026 Spring Meetings from April 13 to 18 in Washington, D.C.

The meetings are one of the year's recurring focal points for global economic governance, bringing together policymakers and institutions around growth, financial stability, development, and poverty reduction.
